$schema_note: LUMI design tokens v2.0.1 (2026-08-07). Mirrors tokens/lumi-theme.css; usage in references/design-rules.md. Version lockstep: tokens carry the skill version. Repository language: English only (red line).

dark.note: applied only on explicit user request, via one body.dark override block — never a forked file

palette.note: one structure, two palettes. v2.0.0: the light canvas is pure white, not the warm cream the field has settled on, and the dark canvas is Apple space grey. The state palette grew by two with fixed meanings: amber = partial, in progress, awaiting an input; brass = reference, archival, out of scope but real. Before this, partial and not-built both rendered as dashed grey, so a deck could not say the one thing it most needed to say about itself. Every semantic colour clears 4.5:1 as text on its own canvas.

contrast.note: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratios, recomputed by scripts/check_design.py (D1). Recompute and update this block whenever a palette value moves; the numbers are the reason the alphas are what they are.

chart.note: CVD-validated triple; on dark canvas use the lifted forms from palette.dark

font.note: v1.2+: D-DIN is the single Latin face (titles ALL-CAPS weight 400, tight leading; CJK titles: weight 700 + 0.04em tracking, no uppercase). SIL OFL (Datto 2017), Latin-only; vendored in assets/fonts/ and embedded by scripts/embed_font.py. tabular-nums always on for data.

typography.note: v1.8.0 raised the chart scale and added size_floor_px. The old scale (11 / 10.5 / 9.5) contradicted design-rules.md prose (14 / 10-11 / 11); tokens win per CLAUDE.md, so deliverables shipped 9.5px source lines. size_floor_px binds every text run except chart_scale_px.source, the single documented exception.

assets.icons: assets/icons/ — the eight semantic icons named in design-rules.md §5, hairline 1.25px, stroke=currentColor, 24x24
assets.vectors: assets/vectors/ — globe-orthographic.svg and world-flat.svg, original geometry
assets.note: v1.8.0. A rule may not mandate an asset the package does not ship: §5 required a semantic icon library for six versions and shipped none, so deliverables carried zero icons, and the cover rule banned imagery because there was no photo library rather than shipping vector geography that needs none.

layout.tier1_callouts: at most 1 per page, and no more than a third of a deck's pages
layout.footer: source line + page number as N / total
layout.verification_matrix: language x viewport (design / print / short-laptop); footer visible at every point
